text: Opening screen is clear: HUD shows version 0.0, users, modules, health, weight, next release 33 m uphill; tutorial text explains push (W) and patch (hold E). Good onboarding.
Shipped 0.1 after ~29 s of pushing (w then Shift+w). Clear toast 'Shipped 0.1. New module: search.' Users 10->50, modules 6->7. Satisfying.

In first-person (V) near the boulder, scanning with look: the crosshair label said 'storage' over both dark-green and gold faces, then 'parser' over gold. Could not tell which colour patch is which module; the module colours carry no names and the issue list doesn't say where 'search' is on the boulder.

Stopping on the slope (to look around for the 'search' module and hold E) let the boulder roll back down to the 0.1 terrace, 16 m of progress lost. The opening text never warned that the boulder rolls back if you stop pushing mid-slope; I learned it only after it happened. Expected: a warning before, or at least a grace period.

After the roll-back I spent several minutes walking around the boulder on the 0.1 terrace trying to get below it. The 'From up here...' hint toggles on and off as I circle it, but nothing on screen says which way is uphill (no arrow, path is hard to read on a software renderer). Orientation was the hardest part.

Patching works well once found: aimed at the yellow-green module with a floating 'auth' label, held E 2 s, it went to 'auth: healthy (100%)', turned teal and left the issue list. Rotting modules being tinted and labelled in-world is a great cue.

The patch/retire target is not what the crosshair is on: in first person with the crosshair on open ground beside the boulder, the prompt still reads 'auth: healthy (98%) Hold E to patch'. Same earlier ('storage' over two different coloured faces). Expected the prompt to name the face under the crosshair, or say what it picks.

Walking into the boulder from below with Shift+W, aimed at it in third person, repeatedly slid past it instead of pushing (3 times this session); next shot I'm 11-20 m up the hill with 'The boulder: 11 m behind you'. Expected the boulder to catch the walker, or a clear 'pushing' state; slightly off-centre contact seems to deflect the player around it.

From directly below on the path with the boulder centred, 'pt hold w 5' moved it only 1 m (28->27 m) then the boulder slid off to the side and 'It is rolling back down!' appeared while I kept walking up the empty path. Pushing worked reliably for 0.0->0.1 but never again from the 0.1 terrace.

Patched core (deprecated API, 60%) with E: progress bar 'Patching [#########....]' after 1.5 s, done after more holding; 'No open issues. It will not last.' Nice line. Note core's rotting face was not tinted yellow-green like auth's was, so it was harder to spot.

Patching 'router' while 1 m up the slope from the 0.1 terrace: the boulder rolled back mid-patch ('It is rolling back down!'), the patch did not complete (78%) and the target switched to 'auth: rotting'. So upkeep is only possible on terraces, but nothing tells the player that before it happens.

Final state after ~30 min: still version 0.1, boulder resting at the top of the 0.1 terrace, 27 m from 0.2. Seven push attempts from below (third person and first person, plain W and Shift+W, and micro-steering left between 0.6 s pushes) each gained at most 1 m before the walker slid off its right side. Never reached 0.2.
